description.en: Update your identity and address details with your bank (re-KYC).
description.ta: உங்கள் வங்கியில் அடையாள மற்றும் முகவரி விவரங்களைப் புதுப்பிக்க (மறு-KYC).
description.hi: अपने बैंक में पहचान और पते की जानकारी अपडेट करें (री-KYC)।
description.or: ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କରେ ପରିଚୟ ଓ ଠିକଣା ବିବରଣୀ ଅପଡେଟ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ (ରି-KYC)।

submit_note: Submit at your home branch with self-attested copies; carry originals for verification. Many banks also accept re-KYC online or through a self-declaration if nothing has changed.

question.en: Which document are you giving as proof?

fields.explain: Banks accept 'Officially Valid Documents' (OVDs): passport, driving licence, voter ID, NREGA job card, Aadhaar (proof of possession), or a letter from the National Population Register.

question.en: What is the number printed on that document?

fields.explain: The ID number on the document you selected. For Aadhaar, banks usually only need the last 4 digits written - the rest can be masked.

documents: Self-attested copy of the ID/address proof you selected (carry the original)
PAN card copy, or Form 60 if you don't have a PAN
